newsitem.title: UK: BA falls on threat to American alliance.
newsitem.headline: BA falls on threat to American alliance.

text.p: British Airways shares fell 10-1/2 pence to 725-1/2 following a report saying the European Commission wants the proposed alliance between BA and American Airlines to be changed.
A source at European Commission told Reuters that it will tell the British government later today that the planned tie-up would harm fair competition unless altered.
Analysts said the report came as no surpise as the Commission's concerns over airline competition were widely known.
But they added that any changes demanded by the Commission could mean serious delays to any link-up coming into effect.
"It not a surprise to the market -- more a disappointment and the fact that it could mean further delays to getting this alliance implemented," said one industry watcher.
The alliance plan, announced nearly a year ago, is been reviewed by the UK government in tandem with investigations by the European Union and the United States.

American last week repeated its call for governments to give the green light following the announcement of a rival partnership, called Star Alliance. This includes Deutsche Lufthansa AG, United Airlines, SAS, Air Canada, Thai International Airways Ltd and Varig.
